visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a handheld shot following a man from behind as he walks down a paved sidewalk next to green grass and dry leaves. He is wearing a white t-shirt and blue shorts. (2) A hand reaches down into a patch of weeds and picks a long green bristlegrass stalk. The camera then shows the hand throwing the grass at the back of the walking man, but the grass falls immediately to the ground. (3) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of a man looking upward with a skeptical expression. He is wearing a beige t-shirt with a black strap across his chest. The background shows trees and an elevated railway structure. (4) A quick transition shows a different man in a blue patterned shirt standing in an urban setting with Japanese signage and a taxi in the background. He examines green plants. (5) The man from phase 3 is seen again, now wearing a different shirt, talking directly to the camera in what appears to be an indoor setting with soft lighting. Social media comment overlays appear around him. (6) A screen recording shows a Google search interface with traditional Chinese characters and an AI summary from Gemini. (7) The scene shifts to Hualien railway station, showing a large pillar with the name 'Hualien' on it. (8) A POV shot from a bicycle basket shows the man riding along a paved road in a sunny outdoor area. (9) The man finds a large green bristlegrass by the roadside and demonstrates its stickiness by throwing it onto his grey t-shirt; it stays attached. He looks into the lens with a wide-eyed, triumphant expression. (10) The final shot is a mirror selfie showing the man with multiple grass stalks stuck all over his grey shirt.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous short-form vlog where the creator attempts to prove to his audience and an AI that a specific type of 'dog tail grass' (green bristlegrass) found in his childhood home of Hualien actually sticks to clothing, unlike the varieties found elsewhere which people often confuse with Bidens pilosa.
